provenance_note: Expected requirements were computed by bench-src/ref/gen_acousticreqbe.py, an independent Python transcription of NBN S 01-400-1:2022 Tab. 1–6, §5.3–5.4, §6.3–6.4, §8.2–8.4, §9.2 and NBN S 01-400-3:2026 §5.2, §6.2, Tab. 1–12, 15, 16, Annex A Tab. A.1, Tab. B.1, Tab. C.1 and Annex E Tab. E.1, written as named decision rules from the rendered pages, not from the page code. Shared reading with the engine (not independent): the mapping of the tool space list onto table rows / columns that group several spaces, the RA,50 / LI,50 applicability, the Note 2 interpretation (only towards dwellings without LAeq), the §5.2 +(LAeq,15min − 80) increase only towards dwellings (la_req_act3), no door relief on a Tab. 2 note 3 / Tab. 4 note 3 value and door relief judged on the sending space (la_req_conf), and the nearest-row choice of εspat. Written from the clause in r3-fix (not a shared reading): part 1 Tab. 2 row 2 only for a common circulation on the same floor that is not a staircase; part 3 §9.3 Tnom ≥ 0,4 s, measured + 10 %, other furnishing state × 0,9 / × 1,1; §9.2 verdict (design: Tab. 15 sufficient; measured Tnom met → Tab. 15 cancelled, else Tab. 15 with workmanship). External anchors: the values stated in the running text of part 3 §5.2 / §6.2 and part 1 §9.2.
